name: Code Concat & LLM Context Packer
description: High-performance repository and directory packer for LLMs. Concatenates code, computes token counts, respects gitignore, and structures context with XML/Markdown formatting without third-party APIs.
author: Flowork OS Sovereign Organ

target_path.description: Target workspace directory or file path to pack

output_file.description: Output path for concatenated context package

include_tree.description: Whether to include repository ASCII directory tree

token_count.description: Whether to estimate and report token counts
